item.title: Who is George Liele? What your church should know.
item.description: We hear about George Liele every year during the Southern Baptist Convention’s George Liele Church Planting, Evangelism and Missions Sunday (Feb. 1). But who is this celebrated man? What every church should know about George Liele

item.title: Pastor Connections: Preparing for winter woes, ministry burnout and when protesters show up
item.description: A few tips and more for pastors from pastors and church leaders.

item.title: Felt Needs series: How churches can nurture, protect marriage
item.description: When a pastor looks out over the congregation each Sunday morning, he sees concrete evidence marriage commitments and family dynamics have changed drastically from a generation ago.

item.title: Alabama lawmakers address AI with several bills
item.description: As the use of artificial intelligence spreads to all corners of life, Alabama lawmakers are introducing bills to put a few limits on how Alabamians interact with AI.

item.title: Embrace help from Holy Spirit, Ratner urges students
item.description: During the University of Mobile chapel service on January 28, Heiden Ratner, the senior pastor of WALK Church in Las Vegas, Nevada shared a message with students about their need for the Holy Spirit.

item.title: Alabama House passes bill requiring reporting parents whose children smell of marijuana
item.description: The House of Representatives passed a bill Thursday requiring certain people to report parents whose children smell like marijuana smoke.

item.title: Alabama Senate passes bill prohibiting elder abusers from profiting from deaths
item.description: The Senate Thursday also passed Sen. Keith Kelley’s Senate Bill 41 to prohibit people who are convicted of elder abuse and neglect or financial exploitation of an elderly person from profiting from that person’s death.

item.title: Disaster relief volunteers work in Mississippi after winter storm, in Alabama after tornado, winds
item.description: After a winter storm swept across north Mississippi in late January — at the same time a tornado and straight-line winds affected south Alabama — Alabama Baptist Disaster Relief teams are hard at work.
